description: Postcards from Space is a Phoenix team of 11th graders building a web app for the “Abandoned but not Forgotten” challenge, in which the hardware NASA left on the Moon, on Mars and in deep space writes postcards to school-age kids about what it discovered and where it is today. There’s a strong Arizona thread: UA led the Phoenix Mars Lander and runs the HiRISE camera that still photographs it, ASU’s LROC camera images Apollo hardware on the Moon, and every moonwalker trained in Flagstaff.
